match_rule: Simulated Fidaty instant = when the person is furthest along the lane. Certain: nobody else in that lane (or overlapping pair), or this person is at least 0.8 m nearer the terminal. Risky: someone else is at least 0.8 m nearer. Uncertain: in between.
pairs_note: Lanes 2-3, 5-6 and 7-8 have overlapping zones in the twin and are reported as pairs.
definition: Queuing / paying = a WAITING visit (mean speed < 0.5 m/s, not a fixed object) in a checkout queue / service zone. Payment session = WAITING service visit >= 10 s.
